title: Urology and Continence Supply Program covered items and monthly allowances
content:
The Urology and Continence Supply Program is supplied by product line, and each tier sets how many billing units of each item it covers per 30 days of supply. A billing unit is each catheter, drainage bag, brief, liner or underpad.

## Items a program of each product line may receive (all tiers)

| Product line | Items |
|---|---|
| Intermittent catheter | A4351 (straight-tip), A4352 (coude-tip), A4353 (closed-system kit with insertion supplies) |
| External catheter | A4349 (external catheter), A4357 and A4358 (drainage bags) |
| Indwelling catheter | A4338 (indwelling catheter), A4357 and A4358 (drainage bags) |
| Absorbent products | T4521, T4522, T4523 and T4524 (briefs), T4535 (liners), A4554 (underpads) |

## Monthly allowance per item (billing units per 30 days of supply)

An allowance of 0 means the item is not covered on that tier.

| Item | Continence Self-Pay Program | Continence Commercial HMO Program | Continence Commercial PPO Program | Continence Medicare Advantage Program | Continence Original Medicare Program | Continence Medicaid Program |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A4351 (straight-tip intermittent catheter) | 200 | 150 | 200 | 200 | 200 | 200 |
| A4352 (coude-tip intermittent catheter) | 200 | 150 | 200 | 200 | 200 | 200 |
| A4353 (closed-system intermittent catheter kit with insertion supplies) | 200 | 120 | 200 | 200 | 200 | 200 |
| A4349 (external catheter) | 35 | 31 | 35 | 35 | 35 | 35 |
| A4338 (indwelling catheter) | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 |
| A4357 (drainage bag) | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 |
| A4358 (drainage bag) | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 |
| T4521 (brief) | 300 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 200 |
| T4522 (brief) | 300 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 200 |
| T4523 (brief) | 300 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 200 |
| T4524 (brief) | 300 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 200 |
| T4535 (liner) | 300 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 200 |
| A4554 (underpad) | 150 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 120 |


## Absorbent products

| Basis | Continence Self-Pay Program | Continence Commercial HMO Program | Continence Commercial PPO Program | Continence Medicare Advantage Program | Continence Original Medicare Program | Continence Medicaid Program |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Absorbent products covered | Yes | No | No | No | No | Yes |
| Combined briefs and liners (T4521 to T4524 and T4535) per 30 days, all sizes | 300 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 200 |


Medicare and commercial plans do not cover absorbent products. A combined figure of 0 means absorbent products are not covered.

## Product lines never supplied together (all tiers)

- An indwelling catheter line and an intermittent catheter line.
- An indwelling catheter line and an external catheter line.

## Points of reading

- **Hypothetical case:** a Continence Medicaid Program customer receiving two sizes of briefs and a liner. The briefs and liner together count against the combined 200 units per 30 days, whatever their sizes.
- On the Continence Commercial HMO Program the closed-system kit allowance is 120 units per 30 days, while the straight-tip allowance is 150.
